title: 第10章 石芯是什么？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    许默的视线飞速扫向界面右上角的区域信息，瞳孔骤然收缩。

    【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：1023】

    “一千人……”

    许默喉结艰难地滚动了一下。

    蓝星传送过来的人口基数是多少他不知道，但仅仅第三天，哪怕一个区域只有一万人，这高达九成的死亡率也足以让人如坠冰窟。

    “别看了，看公屏。”

    方芸眉头紧锁，手指在空中快速滑动。

    世界频道此刻已经彻底炸锅，无数带着头像的幸存者正在疯狂刷屏。

    【李强：卧槽！我的背包里怎么多了一个发光的石头？】

    【王建国：那是庇护所基石！系统刚才提示了，每个人都有一次建立庇护所的机会！】

    【赵芳：别乱放！我刚才不小心放在沼泽地里，结果地基一直下沉，耐久狂掉，根本收不回来！系统说机会有一次，但没交代只有一次啊！】

    庇护所？

    许默猛地切开自己的物品栏，果然静静躺着一块散发着微光的灰色石块。

    一次性道具。

    位置、环境、隐蔽性，甚至是周边的资源产出，每一个因素都决定了这个庇护所未来的发展上限。

    许默的大脑飞速运转，在这荒郊野岭绝不是建立大本营的好地方，必须得留一手，等摸清了区域地图再说。

    然而下一刻。

    一声极其沉闷的空间震荡声突兀在山洞里炸响。

    脚下的岩石烈摇晃起来。

    无数幽蓝色的光线从方芸的掌心疯狂喷涌而出，如同具有生命的藤蔓般迅速攀附上山洞的四周岩壁！

    许默猛地站起身，手里的战术手斧瞬间反握，难以置信地盯着方芸。

    “你疯了？连地形都不探就直接把基石用了？”

    方芸拍了拍手上的灰尘，指着洞穴中央那块渐渐浮现出的蓝色水晶操作台。

    “我的直觉一向很准，这地方，有货。”

    几行璀璨的幽蓝色字迹直接弹入两人的视野。

    【方芸的庇护所】

    【品质：蓝色（隐藏地貌加成）】

    【等阶：1级】

    【耐久：200/200】

    【升级材料：1级石芯*1，1级石材*100。】

    【维护消耗：石窟需要能源运转。当前能源：86/100】

    【特性·石灵庇佑：身处其中时，体力值和健康值恢复速度+4/每小时，锻造成功率+5%。】
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xu Mo's eyes quickly glanced at the regional information in the upper right corner of the interface, and his pupils suddenly shrank.

【Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 1023】

"One thousand people..."

Xu Mo’s Adam’s apple rolled with difficulty.

He didn’t know what the population base transmitted by Blue Star was, but on only the third day, even if there were only 10,000 people in an area, the 90% mortality rate was enough to make people fall into an ice cave.

"Stop watching, watch the public screen."

Fang Yun frowned and slid her fingers quickly in the air.

The World Channel has completely exploded at this moment, and countless survivors with avatars are frantically swiping the screen.

【Li Qiang: Damn it!Why is there an extra glowing stone in my backpack?】

【Wang Jianguo: That is the cornerstone of the shelter!The system just prompted that everyone has a chance to build a shelter!】

【Zhao Fang: Don't put it around!I accidentally placed it in the swamp just now, and the foundation kept sinking. Its durability was greatly reduced, and it was impossible to get it back!The system said there was only one chance, but it didn’t say there was only one chance!】

Shelter?

Xu Mo suddenly cut open his inventory, and sure enough, there was a shimmering gray stone lying quietly.

​ Disposable props.

Location, environment, concealment, and even the surrounding resource output, each factor determines the future development limit of this shelter.

Xu Mo's brain was racing. This wilderness was by no means a good place to set up a base camp. He had to be cautious until he had a clear map of the area.

But the next moment.

An extremely dull space vibration suddenly exploded in the cave.

The rocks beneath my feet shook violently.

Countless blue rays of light spurted out from Fang Yun’s palm and quickly climbed up the surrounding rock walls of the cave like living vines!

Xu Mo stood up suddenly, holding the tactical ax in his hand backwards, staring at Fang Yun in disbelief.

"Are you crazy? You just used the cornerstone without even exploring the terrain?"

Fang Yun patted the dust on her hands and pointed at the blue crystal console that gradually emerged in the center of the cave.

"My intuition has always been very accurate. This place has the goods."

A few lines of bright blue handwriting bounced directly into the two people's field of vision.

【Fang Yun's Shelter】

【Quality: blue (hidden landform bonus)】

【Level: Level 1】

【Durability: 200/200】

【Upgrade materials: Level 1 stone core*1, Level 1 stone material*100.】

【Maintenance consumption: The grotto requires energy to operate.Current energy: 86/100]

【Characteristics·Shiling Blessing: When inside, the recovery speed of physical strength and health value is +4/hour, and the forging efficiency is +5%.】
